data.name: Mareah
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Mareah was a goddess of rebellion and revolt. She was the daughter of the Titan Atlas and the Oceanid Pleione. In the Bible, Mareah is not mentioned directly, but her name is mentioned in connection with a place called Marah, which means 'bitter', in the book of Exodus.
